prompt:
A multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 2 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 6 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a clean photorealistic cinematic film still with natural skin texture and real adult faces, the same light and colour in every panel. Thin plain white gutters separate the panels. Location: JI RAN'S OFFICE, Day, bright soft daylight through floor-to-ceiling windows.
Image 1: the character sheet of 纪然 (27), look S0
Image 2: the location JI RAN'S OFFICE, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 3: the location JI RAN'S OFFICE, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 4: the location JI RAN'S OFFICE, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 5: the location JI RAN'S OFFICE, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 6: the location JI RAN'S OFFICE, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 7: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 8: the prop pour-over coffee equipment; use only structure, material, and color
Image 9: the prop coffee; use only structure, material, and color
Keep each character's face, hairstyle, body and outfit exactly as in their reference image. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the space, materials and light. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Ji Ran stands behind the walnut desk, in front of the black leather executive chair, her back to the floor-to-ceiling windows and facing the office door. One hand is braced flat on the desk; the other holds the gooseneck kettle over the dripper. On the walnut desk lie architectural plans, wood samples and one metal figurine. The pour-over set (kettle, white cone dripper on a glass server) stands in the middle of the desk, with one white coffee cup beside the server. The camera is in front of the desk, on the office door side, and stays on that side.
Panel 1: Wide shot, slow push in from the office door side toward the walnut desk, eye-level. Ji Ran stands behind the walnut desk with the windows glowing behind her. One hand is braced on the desk while she pours water from the kettle into the dripper. Her face is cold.
Panel 2: Extreme close-up insert, locked-off camera, high angle on the dripper. Water spirals from the kettle spout into the paper filter, and dark coffee drips into the glass server.
Panel 3: Medium close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, from the office door side. Ji Ran keeps pouring with her mouth closed, and her eyes lift coldly from the dripper.
Panel 4: Medium shot, low angle from in front of the desk, slight tilt up. Ji Ran sets the kettle down on the walnut desk and straightens, leaning on her braced hand with her mouth closed.
Panel 5: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level, on Ji Ran's face. Ji Ran gives a thin, icy smile.
Panel 6: Extreme close-up insert, high angle on her braced hand. Ji Ran's fingers press down hard on the architectural plans beside the white coffee cup.
Keep the characters' identities and outfits, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no sketch or comic style.
